name: 1-2-Dynamic Word Search!
summary: 1-2-Dynamic Word Search is the fifth game in the 1-2-Word Search series. Building upon the previous entries this classic word search puzzle game returns with a brand new set of levels, themes, and one new big twist, multiplayer! In Dynamic Word search you can play local multiplayer with up to four friends and solve classic word search puzzles together! Although this is a cooperative experience, the game keeps track of which player finds the most words! This way you can compete with your friends and family as you work together to sovle each puzzle! Dynamic Word Search packs in all new hand crafted puzzles built on 3 different grid sizes, 7x7, 10x10, and 12x12. Choose your puzzle solving mood by changing the background theme set and switching up the music on the TreeFall Radio. Embark on a fun and relaxing journey solving word searches in 1-2-Dynamic Word Search! Fun new puzzles await the discerning eye.
